note: Hebrew word order (read right to left), from STEPBible's amalgamated Hebrew Old Testament, with transliteration.

verses.transliteration: halu yah halu- 'el bekadesho haluhu birkia' uzo
verses.hebrew: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ\׀ הַֽלְלוּ\־ אֵ֥ל בְּקָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בִּרְקִ֥יעַ עֻזּֽוֹ\׃

verses.transliteration: haluhu beteka' shofar haluhu benevel vekhinor
verses.hebrew: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְּתֵ֣קַע שׁוֹפָ֑ר הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּנֵ֣בֶל וְכִנּֽוֹר\׃

verses.transliteration: haluhu vetof umachol haluhu beminim ve'ugav
verses.hebrew: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְתֹ֣ף וּמָח֑וֹל הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּמִנִּ֥ים וְעוּגָֽב\׃

verses.transliteration: haluhu vetziltzelei- shama' haluhu betziltzelei teru'ah
verses.hebrew: הַֽלְל֥וּהוּ בְצִלְצְלֵי\־ שָׁ֑מַע הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּֽצִלְצְלֵ֥י תְרוּעָֽה\׃

verses.transliteration: kol haneshamah tehalel yah halu- yah
